text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's been raining like mad since this morning. Amid the occasional thunderclaps, T.M. Opera O begins to shout.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hark, you sky! Mark my words! I will not yield to your storms!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Braids
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… Give it a rest, Oppy. There's nothing you can do when it's raining this hard.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Ponytails
text_block_list.text: We have to let the fans know it's canceled now. What a shame—we'd been preparing for so long.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Do not lose heart!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: There's still time! Please… put your faith in me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, um… You see…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: We were supposed to put on a play outside today.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: It was going to be part of our volunteer work. But in this weather, well…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: No! The heavens are merely testing my resolve!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pat, pat, pat!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uwhaa?! O-Opera O?! Where are you—

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hear me, sky! You heavens! You bolts of lightning! Try as you may, you cannot drown out my voice!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I chase after Opera O, who seems to be heading for the roof. I race up the stairs, desperate to keep up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoosh! Crack! Boom!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I will inspire the people! Be there rain in my face, wind in my hair, or thunder in my ears!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: My will shall never waver! For it is I!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The Centurial Overlord… The T.M. Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I watch her howling at the sky while she gets battered by the elements.
choice_data_list: Are you trying to catch a cold?!
Are you trying to catch a cold?!
Hear me rain! Stop this instant!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I watch her howling at the sky while she gets battered by the elements.
choice_data_list: Are you trying to catch a cold?!
Are you trying to catch a cold?!
Hear me rain! Stop this instant!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I lead her back inside to put on some dry clothes right away.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Alas, I could not convey to the heavens the entirety of my conviction.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: B-but… you would have caught a cold if you stayed any longer.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: …H-huh?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O, look! Out the window!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Gasp… Could it be?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The rain… It has ceased!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: At this rate, it should be sunny by the afternoon!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha! You heard me in the end, o heavens!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Though you might act again in defiance, know that I remain standing!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Rebel all you wish, but my will shall never falter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The sun comes out in full force that afternoon, not a cloud left to be seen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O shines even brighter than usual among the glistening water droplets that dress the surrounding trees, and the crowd gives a standing ovation as the curtain falls.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After we spend some time yelling at the sky, I lead her inside to put some dry clothes on right away.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Going out in the middle of a downpour… You're going to get yourself sick.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Heh… Anything less would not have gotten my feelings across to that mischievous sky.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: See for yourself!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wh-what?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: No way… The rain stopped!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha! Behold the power of my will!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Even the sun cannot bear to go without my radiance!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Praise me if you must! For I am—

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, no! I-I'll go get some tea!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The sun comes out in full force that afternoon, not a cloud left to be seen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O appears fine. In fact, she shines brighter than ever, and her performance goes off without a hitch.
